learning_objective: 🎯 To spark your curiosity and learn how to explore the natural world by observing, asking questions, and testing ideas like a real scientist!

main_concepts.simple_explanation: Science is not just a subject in a book, it is a fun way of understanding everything around us! It is all about asking curious questions like 'Why is the sky blue?' or 'How do plants grow?' and finding the true answers.

The first step to being a scientist is looking closely at the world. When you use your eyes, ears, nose, and skin to notice small details about an object or an event, you are making important observations.

Scientists follow a special path to discover new things. They observe something interesting, make a smart guess about why it happens, and then do a fun test or experiment to see if their guess was right!

fun_activity.title: 🔬 The Backyard Explorer
fun_activity.instructions: Go outside to a park or your garden and pick one interesting leaf, bug, or stone to observe closely for 5 minutes. Write down three curious questions you have about it in your science notebook!

quick_recap: ⭐ Science is all about exploring the wonders of the natural world with an open mind.
⭐ Observation means paying close attention to details using all of our senses.
⭐ Asking questions and testing our ideas helps us discover the truth and learn amazing new things.
